# reflection

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventTypeReflection`](gmeow-eventTypeReflection.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventTypeReflection>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/metacognition`](../../slices/metacognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An event of an agent reviewing its OWN reasoning — re-examining a prior inference, belief, or self-assessment. A value individual of [`gmeow:EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md) (the [`eventTypeDeception`](gmeow-eventTypeDeception.md) pattern), so a reflection is typed and queryable as an occurrent kind. A reflection may install a [`gmeow:hasDefeater`](../properties/gmeow-hasDefeater.md) on one of the agent's own [`gmeow:InferenceCommitment`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceCommitment.md) individuals, triggering belief revision — modelled as SUPPRESSION ([`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false on the defeated conclusion, the prior inference retained as audit), never deletion ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)). The bridge to the inference slice is documented routing, not an axiom.

## Structure

**Types:** [`gmeow:EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:eventTypeReflection`](gmeow-eventTypeReflection.md) as a controlled value typed as [`gmeow:EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md).

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example — REFLECTION defeating one's own inference, belief revision as
# SUPPRESSION (Principle 10). The metacognition layer over the inference slice's
# belief-revision pattern: Lillith inductively concluded "the server is down" from
# "the ping timed out". On REFLECTION (a gmeow:Event typed gmeow:eventTypeReflection,
# tied to the reflexive layer by a gmeow:MetacognitiveState whose gmeow:metaTarget
# is her OWN gmeow:InferenceCommitment) she surfaces an UNDERCUTTING defeater — a
# firewall rule blocked the ping, removing the warrant. Revision does NOT delete:
# the conclusion-claim is set gmeow:displayable false, the gmeow:InferenceTenure is
# closed, and the gmeow:InferenceCommitment is retained as audit. The defeater is
# installed via the inference slice's gmeow:hasDefeater (reused by reference); the
# reflection → revision link is a documented bridge, never an axiom.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/metacognition/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

# --- The reflection act: Lillith reviews her OWN reasoning (the metacognition
#     layer). The event carries the gmeow:eventTypeReflection value; a
#     gmeow:MetacognitiveState ties the review to the reflexive layer, its
#     gmeow:metaTarget pointing at her own inference commitment.
ex:lillithReview a gmeow:Event ;
    gmeow:eventType gmeow:eventTypeReflection .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to type an event of an agent reviewing its own reasoning — a reflection act that may revise a prior belief — when the reviewable occurrence is the fact of interest, e.g. recording that a reflection defeated an earlier inference.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the unfolding reasoning EPISODE itself (that is a [`gmeow:MentalProcess`](../classes/gmeow-MentalProcess.md), mentation — one canonical source per fact, [Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)) and avoid treating the reflection→revision link as an entailment; the [`gmeow:hasDefeater`](../properties/gmeow-hasDefeater.md) installation is asserted, not derived.

### How to use

- Type a reflection event with [`gmeow:eventType`](../properties/gmeow-eventType.md) [`gmeow:eventTypeReflection`](gmeow-eventTypeReflection.md); record belief revision by installing [`gmeow:hasDefeater`](../properties/gmeow-hasDefeater.md) on the agent's own [`gmeow:InferenceCommitment`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceCommitment.md) and suppressing the defeated conclusion with [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false, retaining the prior inference as audit ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

### Scope notes

- Boundary with the mentation slice (documentation only): [`gmeow:eventTypeReflection`](gmeow-eventTypeReflection.md) types a reviewable occurrent KIND, like [`gmeow:eventTypeDeception`](gmeow-eventTypeDeception.md). A reflection that unfolds as a reasoning PROCESS is a [`gmeow:MentalProcess`](../classes/gmeow-MentalProcess.md) (mentation); to avoid two canonical sources for one fact ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)), use this [`EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md) for the reviewable act and the mentation process type for the unfolding episode, not both for the same individual.

### Examples

- ex:lillithReview a [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md); [`gmeow:eventType`](../properties/gmeow-eventType.md) [`gmeow:eventTypeReflection`](gmeow-eventTypeReflection.md).
